cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
阵营规则
交融
大部分智慧生物都难以与胡蜂人进行沟通或者
互相理解。而钛星人则通过各种科技辅助与他
们建立起了稳固的关系，其中最为关键的便是
交融头盔。胡蜂人认为这些科技产物是一种有
用的工具，但它们真正的功能和效果依旧不
为人知。
交融点数被用于维持己方胡蜂尖翼特工对战术
目标的专注。在每个战略阶段的就绪步骤中，您
获得 D3 交融点数，如果己方照管无人机特工位
于杀戮区中，那么获得额外 1 点交融点数。交融
点数拥有以下用途（照管无人机特工不受以下效
果的影响)：
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FACTION RULE
COMMUNION
Other species struggle to understand and interact with
Vespids. The T’au have managed to establish strong
links through various technological aids, most notably
their communion helms. The Vespids have accepted
these aids as beneficial, but the true extent of their
impact is unknown.
Communion points are used to maintain the
tactical focus of friendly VESPID STINGWING
operatives. In the Ready step of each Strategy
phase, you gain D3 Communion points, plus 1 if
a friendly OVERSIGHT DRONE operative is in the
killzone. Communion points are used as follows
(OVERSIGHT DRONE operatives aren’t affected by
the following):
RULE CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
1. 在一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工执行射击行动时，
除非您花费 1 点交融点数，否则该特工只能
将其 8" 内的最近敌方特工作为射击目标（位
于其他己方胡蜂尖翼特工控制范围内的敌方
特工除外)。如果是使用拥有“爆炸”或“洪
流”武器规则的武器进行射击，那么只有第一
个被选择的目标需要满足上述条件。
2. 在一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工（无人机除外）执
行冲锋行动时，该特工必须在与其距离最近的
敌方特工的控制范围内完成那次行动，除非您
花费 1 点交融点数。
3. 在您使用己方胡蜂尖翼特工执行拾取标识行
动或者任务行动时（操作舱门除外)，您必须
花费 1 点交融点数才能执行那次行动。
4. 在一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工进行射击时，您可
以花费 1 点（且仅限 1 点）交融点数来重掷一
枚攻击骰。
cards.text_en:
1. Whenever a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative is performing the Shoot action, it
can only target the closest enemy operative
within 8" of it (excluding enemy operatives
within control range of other friendly VESPID
STINGWING operatives) unless you spend 1 of
your Communion points. For weapons with the
Blast and Torrent weapon rules, only the first
target must be selected in this way.
2. Whenever a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative (excluding DRONE) performs the
Charge action, it must end the action within
control range of the closest enemy operative
it can unless you spend 1 of your
Communion points.
3. Whenever you would perform the Pick
Up Marker or a mission action (excluding
Operate Hatch) with a friendly VESPID
STINGWING operative, you must also spend 1
of your Communion points to do so.
4. Whenever a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative is shooting, you can spend 1 (and
only 1) of your Communion points to re‑roll one
of your attack dice.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
阵营规则
中子充能
中子武器的动力源是来自胡蜂人母星的放射性
晶体。胡蜂人翅膀的震动能够与这些水晶产生
共鸣并进行充能。再厚重的护甲都无法抵挡这
些武器所释放的瓦解性能量。
中子武器是任何名称中带有“中子”一词的武
器，例如中子爆裂枪、中子榴弹发射器等等。
在一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工进行了移动或者飞行
后，其装备的中子武器在转折点结束前拥有“穿
刺 1”武器技能。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FACTION RULE
NEUTRON CHARGE
Neutron weapons are powered by radioactive crystals
from the Vespids’ home world. The harmonic thrumming
of Vespids’ wings resonates within the crystals to
charge them. When unleashed, even heavy combat
armour can barely protect against this atom‑stripping
energy charge.
Neutron weapons are any weapons that have the
word ‘neutron’ in their name, e.g. neutron blaster,
neutron grenade launcher, etc. Whenever a
friendly VESPID STINGWING operative moves or
uses FLY, its neutron weapons have the Piercing
1 weapon rule until the end of the turning point.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
阵营规则
飞行
胡蜂人嗡嗡作响的翅膀能够让他们以极快的速
度进行敏捷的飞行。
每当一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工开始执行需要进行
移动的行动时，该特工可以飞行。若选择飞行，
不要移动特工。作为替代，将特工移出杀戮区，
随后将其部署至完全位于原本位置一定距离内的
地方，这个距离相当于特工的移动属性（如果特
工执行的是冲刺行动，则是 3")。在测量这个距
离时，仅测量水平距离。请注意，通过这种方式
执行冲锋行动的特工不会获得额外的移动距离。
特工必须被部署至可以将其容纳的位置，并且除
了执行冲锋行动外，特工不能被部署至敌方特工
的交战范围内。如果杀戮区使用近距离战斗规则
（例如杀戮区：墓穴世界)，您不能越过或穿过
墙壁地形测量距离，而且特工不能被部署至一个
访问点的另一侧（也就是说，特工不能飞行穿过
舱门过道)。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FACTION RULE
FLY
The thrumming wings of the Vespids bear them aloft
with speed and remarkable agility.
Whenever a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative performs an action in which it moves, it
can FLY. If it does, don’t move it. Instead, remove
it from the killzone and set it back up wholly
within a distance equal to its Move stat (or 3" if
it was a Dash) horizontally of its original location
(in a killzone that uses the close quarters rules,
e.g. Killzone: Tomb World, this distance cannot
be measured over or through Wall terrain, and
that operative cannot be set up on the other side
of an access point – in other words it cannot FLY
through an open hatchway). Note that it gains
no additional distance when performing the
Charge action. It must be set up in a location it
can be placed, and unless it’s the Charge action,
it cannot be set up within control range of an
enemy operative.

VESPID STINGWING

token

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
战略计谋
坚硬外骨骼
天生的外骨骼与甲壳为胡蜂人提供保护，他
们的昆虫韧性可以抵御几乎任何致命伤以外
的攻击。
每当一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工（照管无人机除
外）进行近战或者反击时，对其造成的大于等于
4 的常规伤害减少 1 点。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
STRATEGY PLOY
HARDENED EXOSKELETON
Natural exoskeletal chitin armours the Vespids, giving
them an insectile resilience against all but the most
grievous blows.
Whenever a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative (excluding OVERSIGHT DRONE) is
fighting or retaliating, Normal Dmg of 4 or more
inflicts 1 less damage on it.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
战略计谋
灵敏飞行
胡蜂人在空中飞舞跳动，他们难以预测的飞行
轨迹让敌人没有时间可以进行精确瞄准。
当一名特工在进行反应或打断期间，或者在进行
了移动或被部署的激活中对己方胡蜂尖翼特工
进行射击时，为每一次将要被结算的普通成功掷
一枚 D6。若结果为 5+，那么忽略那次射击造成
的伤害。在每个射击行动流程中，最多只有一枚
攻击骰造成的伤害能被忽略。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
STRATEGY PLOY
AERIAL AGILITY
Vespids jink and weave through the air, following
unpredictable flight paths that confound foes who have
not had time to line up clean shots.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
VESPID STINGWING operative while
counteracting or interrupting, or during an
activation in which that shooting operative moved
or was set up, roll one D6 whenever an attack
dice would inflict Normal Dmg: on a 5+, ignore
that inflicted damage. You cannot ignore more
than one attack dice per Shoot action sequence
this way.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
战略计谋
空中掠食者
掠食性本能让胡蜂人发起致命突袭，从高处扑
向猎物。
当一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工在激活期间进行了移
动或者飞行时，在那次激活结束前，其装备的武
器拥有“平衡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
STRATEGY PLOY
AIRBORNE PREDATORS
Hard‑wired instincts see the Vespids pounce upon
their victims from on high, striking with lethal
predatory intent.
Whenever a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative moves or uses FLY during its activation,
its weapons have the Balanced weapon rule until
the end of that activation.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
战略计谋
蜇刺
胡蜂人腹部如同刺刀一般锋利的尖刺能够被作
为武器使用，它们能够穿透护甲并深深刺入敌
人的体内。
己方胡蜂尖翼特工的尖爪的命中属性提升 1，
并且这些武器拥有“致命 5+”和“震荡”武器
规则。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
STRATEGY PLOY
STING
The bayonet‑like stingers that jut from the Vespids’
abdomens can be employed as weapons, their vicious
barbs piercing plate armour and driving deep into their
victims’ bodies.
Improve the Hit stat of friendly VESPID
STINGWING operatives’ claws by 1, and
those weapons have the Lethal 5+ and Shock
weapon rules.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
交战计谋
复眼
胡蜂人拥有的多重视觉和复杂感官能够与任何
扫描科技披靡。他们在飞过战场时能够轻松发
现那些隐藏起来的敌人。
当一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工在使用了飞行的激活
中执行射击行动时使用此交战计谋。直到那次行
动结束前，在选择有效目标时，将那名己方特
工视作为位于其当前位置上方 3" 的制高点地形
上（该特工受到制高点地形第二条规则效果的影
响)。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FIREFIGHT PLOY
OCELLI
The multispectral eyesight and esoteric sensory acuity
of the Vespids are equal to any scanning technologies.
As they sweep over the battlefield, they easily pick out
even the most well‑concealed enemies.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly VESPID
STINGWING operative performs the Shoot
action during an activation in which it’s used
FLY. Until the end of that action, it gains all
benefits from the first and second main features
of Vantage terrain. When determining the height
difference between operatives for Vantage
terrain rules, treat that friendly operative as
being 3" higher than it currently is (but not when
determining the distance for Communion).

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
交战计谋
窜动飞行
胡蜂人能够以极快的速度进行飞行，他们在交
战期间可以迅速地转移位置。
在一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工执行转移行动时使用
此交战计谋。直到那次行动结束前，该特工可以
移动额外 D3"，如果使用飞行，那么该特工则可
以被部署至额外 D3" 外的位置。无论是上述哪种
情况，该特工在那次转折点接下去的流程中不能
执行近战或者射击行动。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FIREFIGHT PLOY
DARTING FLIGHT
Vespids are capable of tremendous airborne speed,
allowing them to rapidly reposition during a firefight.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly VESPID
STINGWING operative performs the Reposition
action. Until the end of that action, it can move
an additional D3", or be set up an additional
D3" away if it uses FLY. In either case, it cannot
perform Shoot or Fight actions for the rest of the
turning point.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
交战计谋
中子过载
通过某种难以解释的手段，胡蜂人能够迅速拍
打翅膀来强化中子武器的力量并在近距离展开
致命打击。
在一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工进行了移动或者使用
了飞行的转折点中使用中子武器进行射击，并结
算一次关键成功时使用此交战计谋。如果目标
位于该特工的 4" 内，那么对其造成额外 D3 点
伤害。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FIREFIGHT PLOY
NEUTRON OVERLOAD
Augmented in some ineffable fashion by the rapid
wing beats of the Vespids, their neutron weaponry can
unleash horrific point‑blank energy blasts.
Use this firefight ploy when you resolve a critical
success for a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative that’s shooting with a neutron weapon
during an activation in which it’s moved or used
FLY. If the target is within 4" of it, inflict D3
additional damage.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
交战计谋
致命毒液
许多胡蜂人种系都能够在腹部的尖刺上生成神
经毒素和刺激性的化合物，在击中了目标后能
够导致肌肉痉挛或者过敏性的肿胀。
在一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工（照管无人机除外）
进行近战并使用关键成功出击时使用此交战计
谋。那次关键成功造成额外 D3 处伤害。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FIREFIGHT PLOY
VICIOUS VENOM
Many Strains of Vespid produce various neurotoxins
and inflammatory agents from their abdominal stingers,
which can reduce victims to convulsing wrecks or
anaphylactically bloat their flesh to bursting point.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly VESPID
STINGWING operative (excluding OVERSIGHT
DRONE) is fighting and you strike with a critical
success. Inflict D3 additional damage.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
阵营装备
神经刺激素
这种安瓿瓶被隐藏于胡蜂人的护甲下方，其中
含有的化合物能够帮助他们在战斗中进行清晰
的沟通并保持纪律性。
在每个战略阶段的就绪步骤中，在判断您获得多
少交融点数时，您可以掷两枚 D3 并选择其中一
个掷骰结果进行使用。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FACTION EQUIPMENT
NEUROSTIMULANT
Dispensed from ampoules within the Vespid’s armour,
this chemical cocktail is intended to aid the clarity
of communion and ensure discipline is maintained
during battle.
In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, when
determining how many Communion points to
gain, you can roll two D3 and select one D3
to use.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
阵营装备
交融刺激素
这种药物只有在引导员的决定下才能被注射，
在紧急的情况下可以抑制胡蜂人的本能反应并
让他们在极端压力下保持专注。
每个转折点限一次，己方胡蜂尖翼特工可以不
消耗交融点数执行一次拾取标识行动或者任务
行动。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CONVERGENCE STIMULANT
This substance, dispensed only in extreme cases and
at the Shas’ui’s discretion, suppresses the instinctual
responses of the Vespids to aid in mission focus under
extreme stress.
Once per turning point, a friendly VESPID
STINGWING operative can perform the Pick Up
Marker or a mission action without you spending
a Communion point.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
阵营装备
加速刺激素
虽然这种药物存在着受伤和严重疲劳的长期风
险，但它们确实能够在激烈的战斗中加快胡蜂
人的反应。
每当一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工（照管无人机除
外）执行冲锋或冲刺行动时，特工可以移动额外
1"。如果特工在那次行动中使用飞行，那么您可
以将其部署在额外 1" 外的位置。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ACCELERANT STIMULANT
Though it bears long‑term risks of injury or dangerous
fatigue, this stimulant sharpens the Vespids’ reactions
and lends them haste in the heat of battle.
Whenever a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative (excluding OVERSIGHT DRONE)
performs the Charge or Dash action, it can move
an additional 1". If it uses FLY for this action, you
can set it back up 1" further away.

cards.text:
胡蜂尖翼
阵营装备
进攻刺激素
如果胡蜂人小队存在被击败的风险，他们的引
导员可能会批准释放这种高度成瘾性的战斗药
物和攻击增幅剂。
每当一名己方胡蜂尖翼特工（照管无人机除
外）进行近战时，其使用的近战武器拥有“无
休”规则。
cards.text_en:
VESPID STINGWING
FACTION EQUIPMENT
AGGRESSION STIMULANT
Should their Vespids look in danger of being overrun,
a Shas’ui may risk triggering the release of this
highly‑addictive mixture of combat stimulants and
aggression amplifiers.
Whenever a friendly VESPID STINGWING
operative (excluding OVERSIGHT DRONE) is
fighting, its melee weapons have the Ceaseless
weapon rule.
